status: Research specification. This JSON is not a runnable training program.

fixed_training.tokenizer: Train-only SentencePiece unigram; vocab_size=4000; character_coverage=1.0; preserve case, punctuation, emoji, Vietnamese accents
fixed_training.scheduler: constant learning rate within each trial
fixed_training.class_weight_formula: w_c=(N/(7*n_c))**alpha, normalized to mean 1; counts from active training split only
fixed_training.precision: FP32 reference; select a supported mixed precision mode only after numerical validation, then hold fixed for all compared searches
fixed_training.tokenizer_normalization: Apply NFC externally, SentencePiece normalization_rule_name=identity; train tokenizer on active train split only

optional_stage2.requires: sLSTM forward/backward and memory test on target device
optional_stage2.slstm_at: zero-based indices whose character is s
optional_stage2.comparison: Rerun GA and random search in the same expanded space; report separately from stage1

ga.categorical_mutation: resample from all other allowed values
ga.log10_lr_mutation: add Gaussian sigma=0.3; clip to range; round to 4 decimals
ga.fitness: maximum validation Macro-F1 over the 5 proxy epochs, labels 0..6, zero_division=0
ga.infeasible_fitness: negative infinity for OOM or nonfinite loss
ga.cache_key: canonical configuration + data hashes + tokenizer hash + training seed + training budget + code version + precision/backend
ga.duplicate_proposals: use cache; resample until 6 novel trials are scheduled; report attempts separately

selection_after_search.selection_rule: highest mean validation Macro-F1 across reranking seeds; use lower cost only for exact ties
selection_after_search.test_rule: After configuration, seeds and decision rules are locked, evaluate all five models and report all five; no test-driven tuning or best-seed selection

fairness.publication_extension: Compare best-validation-F1 against cumulative GPU time at matched time checkpoints; independent repeats for search stochasticity
